record.name: Kuwait
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. UNDP and the Central Agency for Information Technology assessed the state of AI in Kuwait in September 2026; our searches found no AI safety or evaluation body.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. Recorded English and national or official-language queries and retrieved primary governance evidence support medium confidence. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

check.language_note: The recorded ar query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Some submitted strings contain site. rather than site:; these literal strings are preserved and are not treated as domain-restricted searches. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: KW-search = searches 1, 2 (en, ar). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The UNDP assessment was produced with CAIT; CITRA is another national government body. Two independent evidence origins were not established. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: CITRA's public-consultation page identifies national AI-adoption guidance and its regulatory process; it is a consultation record, not adopted regulation.

related_bodies.name: Central Agency for Information Technology (CAIT)
related_bodies.role: It leads government digital transformation and partnered with UNDP on the AI Landscape Assessment (September 2026).

record.notes:
The CAIT site was unreachable. Secondary reports disagree on finalisation of the national AI strategy. The UNDP/CAIT assessment covers the AI ecosystem, government use, regulation and ethics; its findings were not available in the retrieved release.

CITRA solicited public comments on responsible AI-adoption guidance. Searches covered indexed public English and Arabic sources for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models.

next_check.reason: Publication of the UNDP assessment and any national AI strategy or governance body.
